status: capacity verdict for the factored scheme; native unit-programme lowering absent (stated)

metadata.store: 1 x ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 (U<=128 words used of 1024; overwritten each layer, read only after union done)
metadata.port_schedule: write port: IDX tap phase only (<= 1 write/edge); read port: dispatch phase only (1 read per launch, READ->CAP->FORM->WAIT, >= 4 edges apart)

duration_tables.store: flops (< 2 kb), cfg idle-only, statically indexed by c via registered one-hot select
duration_tables.per_layer_reload: none if all union layers share body shapes (distinct_body_shapes == 2 per mode); else a 40-entry table in the kernel store

kernel_store.content: per (layer, c = 1..N, loop-body record) HGI-1R descriptor, both modes resident (MTP N6 + MU N4)
kernel_store.note: all 40 layers x N kernels resident from boot: no pre-layer load, no runtime code generation; the dispatcher sends (kref = KB[loop] + c - 1, slot) and the unit fetches the descriptor locally

suffix.note: factored: one U-independent suffix per layer (loop trip counts come from the dispatcher), held where the baseline whole-token image is held (no new capacity vs the baseline image)

installed_native_stores.verdict: NOT USED for per-c kernels: no HGI-1R -> calendar lowering exists, so its per-c word count is not derivable; claiming fit would be unproven
per-c kernel descriptors could be armed as base/limit/loops ranges (desc-only rearm reuses a resident image); same lowering gap
